title: Two-pan weight kits
notes: Keep one adult at each table; paper cards represent amounts and the adult may check small sums. On another visit, K-1 can choose among two-weight kits (P4) or add a third weight (P5). Grades 2-3 can compare repeated balances (P4) before the counting bound and fourth-weight kit (P5-6). Grades 4-5 can choose uniqueness (P3), a universal placement bound (P4-5), or the four-/five-weight construction (P6-7). Reuse the same pan convention and deal only the weights in the current kit.
